case_title: HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION VS PARK DONNA J.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,800.08 FILED BY HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT PARK DONNA J. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-04-1990 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 06

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PARK DONNA J. $1,800.88 PRINCIPAL, $47.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,848.38 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
COST BILL AFTER JUDGMENT FILED. $1230.30 CREDIT; $196.90 INTEREST.
DECL OF DEFAULT IN PAYMENTS FILED. BUT RETURNED BECAUSE NO POS OF MAILING TO DEF. PETSA FORM SENT TO SC CONSULTING SERV CK FOR WRT $3.50 RETURNED.
PETITION OF JUDGMENT CREDITOR TO SET ASIDE TERMS FOR PAYMENT OF JUDGMENT FILED BY PLAINTIFF HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION
ORDER TO SET ASIDE TERMS FILED BY PLAINTIFF HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION
WRIT OF EXECUTION ISSUED TO SAN FRANCISCO COUNTY AS TO DEFENDANT PARK DONNA J.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT PARK DONNA J.
